verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no batch or bulk API for acting on many items at once. Payouts, transfers, sends and checkouts are all described per item, and each checkout is explicitly single-use. The only multi-item mention is a webhook subscription that can watch up to 100 wallet addresses; that is an event-notification feature, not a bulk operation capability, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
